Terms.Name: Cohesive
Terms.Description: Together / working efficiently (e.g., Block is secure and working effectively)

Terms.Name: Cohesion
Terms.Description: Sticking together (e.g., Officers are sticking together tightly)

Terms.Name: Non-cohesive
Terms.Description: Separated / working inefficiently (e.g., Squad is separated or down to the last man)

Terms.Name: Tag
Terms.Description: To confirm a kill or identify a target.
